module: Procedurally generates a race route on the map's road graph (map.getMap().nodes). A guided random walk (preferred angle depending on the requested flow, avoidance of U-turns and dead ends, target trail/dirt/tarmac ratios depending on drivability) produces a path, which is smoothed, resampled every 8 m, then reduced to checkpoints by Douglas-Peucker, shifted ahead of sharp turns and validated by A* so that the ground marker properly follows the generated road. A modder calls it with a start position and a target distance.
usage:
local chemin, checkpoints, rayons, normales, distance = gameplay_util_routeGenerator.generateRaceRoute(vec3(x, y, z), 5000, dirDepart, nil, 2)
local depart = gameplay_util_routeGenerator.pickRandomRoadPoint()
notes: Phases: 1 graph walk, 1.5 removal of small deviations on overlapping roads (deviation < 15 m), 1.75 resampling at 8 m, 2 RDP selection (tolerance 30 m, minimum spacing 30 m), 2.5 shifting checkpoints ahead of turns > 45°, 3 A* validation of the ground markers.

Default values: minDrivability 0.35; flow 2 (clamped to 1..3: 1 = pronounced turns, 3 = almost straight); look-ahead (lookAheadDistance) 300 m; distance between checkpoints 130 m; checkpoint radius clamped between 4 and 13 m.
Links whose drivability is below minDrivability are ignored; one-way roads are only traversed in their direction.
Band classification: drivability < bandBoundaries[1] = trail, <= bandBoundaries[2] = dirt, otherwise tarmac. targetRatios is a table {trail, dirt, tarmac} of proportions.
The call reseeds the global random generator (math.randomseed(seed or os.time())): with the same seed and the same map, the result is reproducible, but the game's global random state is modified.
Returns nil if the map has no nodes or if no connected start node is found.
If `job` is provided (a jobsystem job), the function calls job.yield() between phases: it must then run in a jobsystem coroutine.
The first point (player start) is not returned as a checkpoint.

defaultMinDrivability.desc: 0.35. Ground marker routing must use the same value, otherwise phase 3 validates a route the player will never take.

drivabilityPenalty.desc: 10. Drivability penalty to use with ground marker routing.

maxCheckpointRadius.desc: 13 (m). Maximum radius of a generated checkpoint.

generateRaceRoute.desc: Generates a route of the requested length from a position, with checkpoints, radii and normals.

startDir.desc: Start direction, used to choose the road direction; otherwise the nearest connected node.

minDrivability.desc: Minimum drivability of links (0.35 by default).

routeSmoothness.desc: 1 to 3 (2 by default); the higher, the straighter the route.

lookAheadDistance.desc: Look-ahead distance in m (300 by default).

job.desc: Jobsystem job used to yield between phases.

checkpointDistance.desc: Target distance between checkpoints in m (130 by default).

returns.desc: Positions of the path traveled (coarse), nil on failure.

pickRandomRoadPoint.desc: Picks a random position: a random road node, otherwise a random point in the terrain box, otherwise the origin.
